```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(GGally)
```

```{r}
grid <- st_read("data/processed_grid.shp")
grid_df <- read_csv("data/processed_grid.csv")
```

```{r}
names(grid_df)

pairplot_plt <- grid_df %>%
    select(is_indigenous, n_fires, n_xerophyllum, n_rubus, sum_pinus, sum_salix, sum_quercus, sum_populus, sum_thuja, max_acres, min_mgmt, max_duration) %>%
    ggpairs()

ggsave("pairplot_plt.jpeg", pairplot_plt)
```
